name: Golden HR
subtitle: HR office of Golden A/S
promotionalText: Leave approvals, recruiting, job descriptions, the HR year and messages — the HR office of the Golden A/S portal on the phone.
description:
Golden HR is the application of the Human Resources office of Golden Automation Systems (Golden A/S), the marine electrical, automation and navigation systems integrator based in Keratsini, Greece, with branches in Italy and the Netherlands.

An account issued by Golden A/S with the HR role is required. The app is a companion to the Golden A/S portal and is not intended for the general public.

With it the HR manager can:
• see on one page everything that waits for a decision
• approve or reject leave requests, training applications and timesheets
• follow recruiting: candidates by stage, CV reader, evaluations and interviews
• approve job descriptions
• follow the steps of the HR year and what is late
• see contracts, certificates and permits that expire soon
• accept equipment handover lists
• read and answer messages from employees
• see who is away and the leave balances
• In / Out: clock in and clock out with the time and the position at that moment

The app always opens with Face ID or Touch ID and locks after 15 minutes. Decisions are confirmed with an authenticator code. Payroll and other confidential personal data never leave the portal.
whatsNew: New: In / Out under More — clock in and clock out with the time and one position taken at that moment (no tracking in between), after accepting the notice once. Entries of the last 14 days with their status and a map link.
reviewNotes:
1. SCREEN RECORDING
Attached in the Attachment field of this App Review Information section (GoldenHR_review_recording.mp4). Recorded on a physical iPhone with the demonstration account; it shows: launch from the home screen, sign-in, Today, Inbox with a leave request and a training application approved, Messages with a message sent, Recruiting with a candidate and the CV opened, a job description approved, Expiring documents, Equipment, People, Calendar, Leave balances and More.

2. PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
Golden HR is the internal human-resources app of Golden A/S (Golden Automation Systems), a marine electrical and automation company based in Piraeus, Greece. It is used only by the company's HR manager and management. It lets them handle, away from the desk, the HR work that otherwise needs the company web portal: approve or reject leave requests, follow recruiting (vacancies, candidates, CVs, interviews), approve job descriptions, follow the yearly HR plan and expiring documents, confirm equipment hand-overs, and exchange messages with staff. It is not intended for the general public.

3. ACCESS
Sign in with the demo account given in the App Review Information section (HR role, demo data only, no authenticator code needed). After sign-in the app asks for Face ID / Touch ID; this is required because the app shows personnel data. Tabs: Today, Inbox, Recruiting, Messages, More. In / Out (More › In / Out) registers the start and end of work: the notice is accepted once, then when the button is pressed the app asks for the location (When In Use), takes one position and sends it with the time to the company server; there is no background location and no tracking. With the demonstration account the entries are invented and what is registered is not kept in the company records. The link "Open in Google Maps" on an entry opens Google Maps with the stored coordinates. The app has no account registration: accounts are created by the company administrator in the company portal, so there is no in-app account creation or deletion. An employee's account is closed by the administrator when employment ends.

4. EXTERNAL SERVICES
The app talks only to Golden A/S's own server (https://www.goldensas.com) over HTTPS. No third-party analytics, advertising, payment, AI or data-provider service is used. Sign-in uses the company's own accounts, with optional authenticator (TOTP) and passkeys. Face ID / Touch ID is used on the device only.

5. REGIONS
The app works the same in all regions. Languages: English, Greek, Italian.

6. REGULATED CONTENT
None. The app contains no third-party protected material, no purchases and no paid content. Personnel data belongs to Golden A/S and is processed under its privacy policy: https://www.goldenas.com.gr/privacy.html

USER CONTENT
Messages are exchanged only between signed-in employees of the company; there is no public content.

DISTRIBUTION
The app is for the company's own staff. We will request unlisted distribution for it once approved, so that it is not discoverable on the App Store.
